race.comment: FINE STAR (4) tested the waters in 3YO features before a spell, finishing strongly in the Champion Fillies at G3 level. Pulled up with an issue there and was only sighted publicly last month. Won a trial coming in and beat Big Red Zoom that runs in the Simmonds. Can resume on a winning note. COSMIC TREAT (8) was too good at Bunbury last time out when winning by 2.3L under Fiore. This is tougher, but she carries no weight and maps to get every chance in the run. Can repeat the dose without surprising. ROK 'N' ROM (12) was strong on debut before never featuring in the Karrakatta. Fitter for a recent trial and if she gets some luck from the barrier, she can feature. EYE OF THE SUN (9) is better suited out in 1200m and an improved run is on the cards. GOD'S GATE (5) can improve coming back to 1200m.
